subject: Transition: CarePath implementation intake & steward nomination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Eliot Barnes <eliot@carepath.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CarePath — post-sign intake + SOW and next steps

Hi Hannah (and team),

Wrapping up here after the signed MSA — attaching the latest SOW and the pricing-summary for reference. CarePath has committed to the 12-month Dedicated plan with a go-live target of 2026-09-15. Key points to surface for CS:

- Primary use case: triage assistant and discharge summary generation for 3 pilot hospitals (expected 50k tokens/day initially).
- Data residency: US only, logs retained 90 days.
- Security: they requested SOC 2 evidence and an encryption-at-rest confirmation (they are copying procurement).
- Integrations: initial ingestion via SFTP + scheduled API pulls; they may want a one-off bulk migration.
- Single sign-on: Okta recommended (they currently use Okta).

Attachment list: CarePath_SOW_v1.2.pdf, pricing-summary-CP-2026.xlsx, integration-questions-CP.docx

Can we assign a primary CS steward and a secondary technical lead so we can book the kickoff? I indicated a tentative kickoff week of Sep 7 — CarePath prefers mornings PST.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CP-2026-0472

Thanks — feel free to adjust dates if CS bandwidth differs.

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Eliot Barnes <eliot@carepath.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CarePath — post-sign intake + SOW and next steps

Thanks Karthik — and congrats to the team on closing.

Monica — can you take primary stewardship here? Monica, recommended immediate asks:

1) Confirm SSO requirements (Okta) and whether CarePath needs SCIM provisioning.
2) Confirm the exact list of pilot hospitals and point-of-contact for each.
3) Request SOC 2 summary report (we can provide our SOC 2 Type II) and the KMS/HSM details for the Private plan — procurement already copied in.
4) Intake the integration questionnaire and estimate whether we need an uplift for the bulk migration.

Tessa — can you be secondary/ops contact for scheduling and acceptance criteria alignment? Suggest a 30–45m kickoff with Karthik, Monica, CarePath PO and an infra engineer.

Eliot — are you available Sep 8 or Sep 9 (mornings PST) for kickoff? If those are tight, propose two slots and we’ll confirm.

Hannah
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Eliot Barnes <eliot@carepath.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CarePath — post-sign intake + SOW and next steps

Acknowledged — I’ll own this. Initial read-through looks straightforward but two potential flags:

- Bulk migration: depending on volume we may need one additional engineer for a 2-week migration window; I’ll scope after receiving the integration-questions doc.
- Pilot hospital SLAs: need clarity on latency/throughput expectations per hospital (are they all equal?).

Eliot — I’ll pull together a kickoff agenda and pre-kickoff checklist. Can you confirm the pilot hospital list and whether procurement needs a separate meeting for SOC/KMS details? If procurement prefers a separate thread, we can split meetings.

Proposed kickoff slots (all PST):
- Tue Sep 8, 09:00–09:45
- Wed Sep 9, 10:30–11:15

I’ll open a calendar hold once we confirm.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Eliot Barnes <eliot@carepath.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carepath.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CarePath — post-sign intake + SOW and next steps

Hi all,

Thanks — Sep 8 at 09:00 PST works for us. Quick clarifications from procurement and infra:

- We will need a SOC 2 Type II and a short security questionnaire answered before Sep 1. Our procurement team copied here (procurement@carepath.com).
- Pilot hospitals for phase 1: St. Mercy (PO: Laura Kim), Eastbridge (PO: Andre Rios), and Harborview (PO: Mei Chen). I’ll send contact details in a separate email.
- Bulk migration: estimate ~20GB of historical discharge notes. Our infra lead wants to know if Redwood will accept SFTP drop or if we should use an encrypted transfer pipeline.

I’ll expect Monica’s checklist and will loop procurement separately if needed.

Best,
Eliot
Head of Partnerships, CarePath
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CarePath steward assignment + 2-week pre-kickoff checklist

(Internal note — not for external recipients)

Monica / Tessa — tracking items before the Sep 8 kickoff: 
- Send SOC 2 summary and a filled security questionnaire by Fri Jul 30. (I’ll coordinate with security to pull the attestation.)
- Confirm whether we can accept SFTP bulk drop or if we need an encrypted pipeline; schedule a 30m tech sync with our infra lead (Marcus Lin) next week.
- Draft success criteria for pilot hospitals: throughput targets, latency SLO, and data retention window.
- Prepare a resource plan: 1x CS manager (Monica), 1x infra engineer (tentative Marcus), 1x implementation PM (Tessa) and optional migration engineer if bulk migration flagged.
- Add kickoff agenda to the Drive folder and publish meeting notes template.

I’ll take point on the SOC 2 pull and the Drive folder setup. Monica, please confirm resource nominations by EOD Mon Jul 26 so we can send the calendar invite to CarePath.

Hannah
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
